Name: Lynn's Seasonal Wizard SVE version
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
[size=5][color=#d9d2e9]Ok!  This is no longer being updated, it's rolled in to my[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14917]Seasonal Magnus Rasmodeus[/url]﻿ [/size]





Alright folks.  So I've had a really rough go of it lately (Lost my mom to cancer kind of rough go) and I am gonna be honest?  I sorta need a win of some kind.

I've gotten all the art done for my SVE version of the seasonal wizard.  I'm pretty sure I've got everything in the right place?  But we'll have to see, lemme know.  I've got an attempt at the code but it doesn't work 100% of the time and I'm not sure why.  SO!  

Installation if you're ok with it glitching out sometimes:
1. Unzip
2. place in mod's folder
3. Profit!

Installation if you aren't ok with it glitching out:
1. Download this and Seasonal cute Characters (SVE)
2. Unzip both my stuff and SCC(SVE).
3. Put the Assets folder from my mod into the main folder of SCC(SVE) 
4. Let my stuff replace the existing items of those names. (I've intentionally structured my folders like theirs.  So it should just work)
5. Place the modified SCC(SVE) in your mods folder
6. Profit!

Now, I don't have a "no nose" option so the wizard will always have a nose and I've got files in place to essentially erase the file that adds the nose back in so it doesn't give him a weird colored nose.  If someone actually wants the noseless version?  Then just lemme know and I'll do the little bitty edit to make that a thing, I just... *shrug* I didn't see the point in adding that much extra code work when my code was already giving me issues?  

Plans?  Kinda.  I'm gonna keep picking away at the code issues here?  If I figure it out or someone decides to give me a clue I'll update with that?    Some time in the future I'm going to do a Romanceable Rasmodius version, so if anyone is waiting for that, poke me and it might help speed me up.
